name: Ryuuguuin Uran
source: An easygoing girl with long black hair, who wears a haori and does things at her own pace. She gives off an “old Japan atmosphere” to an extreme degree, specializing in things from flower arrangements to tea ceremonies, Japanese-style dancing, and koto. However, since she was raised in isolation from secular society, she has had no ties to men or western culture until now, and cannot bake or speak English.
